title: Rezervations for Two
description: Kit explores new areas of love, beginning with a cozy coffee date and continuing with a hands-on weaving date. Through laughs, conversation and a spark of chemistry, Kit notices the differences between platonic and romantic dates.

title: Friday Night Thunder
description: Ohsweken Speedway faces a difficult decision going into the 2021 season and rain threatens opening day for the Knights of Thunder; when the drivers finally return to the track, one of them has a rough start and ends up brawling with an adversary.

title: Racing Waters
description: After months of preparation, the Island Brave are in Brazil for the World Va'a Long Distance Championships, Facing the world's best crews; the team must rely on trust, resilience and communication to meet the new challenges on the international stage.

title: Horse Warriors
description: The River Cree team faces struggles during practice leading to doubts about their readiness to compete in the season's first show; Old Sun's rider sustains an injury raising concern about his ability to recover in time for the upcoming race.

title: North of 60
description: Eric and Michelle's friendship prompts rumors; Sarah's emotional state affects her work; Teevee gets a job.

title: APTN National News
description: Bringing news stories that matter to Indigenous Peoples.

title: APTN Investigates
description: Dawn Carisse spent a decade inside Ontario's North Bay Psychiatric Hospital before vanishing in 2001; newly uncovered records show what happened behind closed doors and reveal troubling gaps in care; Carisse is one of six patients still missing today.

title: Chums
description: Buddy the wolf cub wants to pull the sled with the other wolves, but Skylar, the pack leader, is against the idea.

title: Lil' Glooscap and the Legend of Turtle Island
description: The kids learn that all families are unique and made up of different types of people; the differences only make a family stronger.

title: Indigenous Art Adventures
description: Follow along with Lance Cardinal to craft a beautiful birch tree art piece using paper straws; learn the Cree word of the day, takwâkin, which means fall.

title: Anaana's Tent
description: Rita Claire arrives at her family's tent on the land with her dog, Qimmiq.

title: Ukaliq and Kalla
description: Ukaliq and Kalla enjoy a weekend at their tent, making tea and bannock after Kalla picks heather; Ukaliq returns from boating with a baby seagull, and Kalla teaches him that caring for a pet is a big responsibility.

title: Dreamcatchers
description: When a headstrong tween has a dream about loggers chopping down an old growth forest, she sets out to stop them; along the way, she discovers she has incredible ancestral superpowers.

title: Le petit Glooscap et les légendes de l'île de la Tortue
description: Les cousins ont établi un campement et s'inquiètent de s'ils auront assez de nourriture pour le petit-déjeuner ; Mémé Muwin leur montre que du bon camping consiste à partager avec les autres et à utiliser les ressources de manière responsable.

title: Savoirs légendaires
description: À travers des récits légendaires, on va à la rencontre des jeunes pour transmettre des savoirs, des valeurs et des leçons de vie tout en perpétuant la tradition de la transmission orale.

title: La brigade
description: Sara et son père ne s'entendent pas sur la façon de dépenser un surplus budgétaire de l'école.

title: Nations des animaux
description: Les communautés autochtones telles que la tribu Kainai Blood renouent avec leurs liens culturels profonds avec les bisons grâce au parc national Elk Island, qui réintroduit l'espèce dans les prairies où elle vivait en vastes troupeaux avant la colonisation.

title: Little Big Community
description: Gabrielle and Amanda, new to Ottawa, are committed to inspiring Indigenous youth and building community; Ottawa, on unceded Anishinaabe Algonquin land, is perfect for their mission with its thriving urban Indigenous population.

title: Animal Nation
description: The Ktunaxa highlight their spiritual connection to grizzly bears through research, conservation and efforts to protect their habitat.

title: The Making of Frozen Planet
description: Documentary crew members brave Earth's most frigid regions to capture the majesty and mystery found in the chillier side of the animal kingdom.

title: James Bay 1975: The Shock of Two Nations
description: The documentary revisits the expansion of the La Grande complex in Northern Quebec, and the story of the Cree and Inuit communities who stood up to protect their land and culture.

title: Best in Miniature
description: The miniaturists compete to have their mini challenge items put on permanent display at Little Canada.

title: APTN National News Weekend
description: Bringing the week full circle with a recap of the top national news stories of the week.

title: APTN Investigates
description: Their sentences may be over, but their struggle is just beginning. APTN Investigates the daunting reality Indigenous women face after leaving Manitoba corrections, where support can be hard to find and starting over is anything but easy.

title: Frozen Planet II
description: An icy adventure through the world's frozen zones where wolves hunt, penguins huddle and life thrives against the most extreme odds.

title: Northwoods Survival
description: It's a return to a life free from the reliance on modern conveniences and away from the hustle and pollution of cities; it's a gamble that comes with a glorious upside, but also frighteningly high stakes.

title: Night Raiders
description: In a post-war future, a mother joins an underground band of vigilantes to try and rescue her daughter from a state-run institution.

description: Jeremy and Jerett commission stained-glass for a door as Jeremy takes on a project overseas; artist Kaija creates a piece for a museum.

title: Chuck and the First Peoples' Kitchen
description: Chuck gets together with Ernest Webb of Chisasibi to learn how to hunt and cook wild goose. This is the meat that members prepare for birthdays, commemorations and ceremonies.

title: Wild Rose Vets
description: Volunteering with the Mission PAWSible mobile vet unit in a remote Indigenous community, Dr. Emma manages loose dogs getting rowdy at the clinic; a routine spay takes a shocking turn when she finds a bullet in a dog.

title: Nunami Piqatigiit: Tundra Friends
description: Aqi feels sad after moving away, but Umi helps her see that she can make new friends; Uka and Natti explain to an upset Tiu-Tiu that she needs to wait to join their game.

title: Tuktu
description: Tiri feels left out when he returns from a trip with his family to see that his friends have made a new friend, Natsiq; Tiri works hard to get to know Natsiq and is happy to have a new friend.

title: Chums
description: A young girl and her furry friends travel across Turtle Island and embark on adventures that help them navigate their connections with each other, other animals and the environment.

title: The Magic Canoe
description: Julie meets Passifou, and she wants to keep him forever, but Passifou gets bored and ends up running away; when she meets Nitap, a teddy bear who wants to keep her with him forever, Julie really understands what she has put Passifou through.

title: Indigenous Art Adventures
description: Cree artist Lance Cardinal demonstrates how to create rock moccasins; Cree word of the day is maskisin, which means moccasin.

title: Coyote's Crazy Smart Science Show
description: Indigenous science shows the forces and energy of nature; the Science Questers learn about non-Newtonian fluids, how fireflies create light, and how traditional knowledge gives people superpowers.

title: La brigade
description: Tout en étant malade et clouée au lit, Sara doit prouver qu'elle n'a rien à voir avec la disparition du four grille-pain de Mme Bizard; Éric est bouleversé par l'arrivée d'un sosie qui remet en cause son unicité.

title: Capteurs de rêves
description: Plus ils sont gros, plus dure est la chute; lorsque les Capteurs de rêves saisissent un rêve dans lequel un centre commercial géant contamine l'eau potable d'une réserve locale, ils doivent trouver la Rêveuse, débloquer ses superpouvoirs ancestraux.

title: Kiuna, plus qu'une école
description: Le marathon de fin de session a commencé à l'Institution Kiuna; des conférences, des ateliers, des kiosques et des rassemblements sont au rendez-vous et permettent aux étudiant·e·s d'en apprendre plus sur leur culture et celle des autres.

title: Red River Gold
description: At a ranger station on the Dawson Trail, the team brings in a drone to get the lay of the land. An object appearing on the thermal imaging piques their curiosity. They find a treasure that belongs in the Dawson Trail Museum.

title: Searchers
description: Jason Crane disappears from Little Bone First Nation during a storm; as hope wanes, his family and community turn to sacred fire and honour songs for spiritual guidance in their search.

title: Water Worlds
description: Estuaries, known as the cradle of life, create some of Earth's most productive ecosystems; over time, human activity has damaged them, but indigenous and non-indigenous communities are working together to restore and preserve these vital areas.

title: The Nature of Things
description: Five orphaned grizzly bear cubs get a second chance at life in the wild; a study follows the bears to find out if rewilding works.
